name: Future We Demand
tagline: You will a good job, and settle down for a home on the prairie with those you love." Was this not the future that was promised to us while growing up?
summary: "Go to school. Get a degree. You will a good job, and settle down for a home on the prairie with those you love." Was this not the future that was promised to us while growing up? Yet, for too many, the dream of a hopeful and bright future has been ever-slipping away against a tide of political apathy and civic disengagement. What is the future that you demand? We often hear platitudes about left vs right, or up vs down. In reality, we are faced with a generational crisis of confidence in the betterment of the future. From job security, to student loan debt, to affording homes, there is a lingering sense of hopelessness and dread about the direction society is moving. Exhaustion and pessimism serve to maintain the status quo. We have set out to reframe the debate; those who hope for a better world, and those who do not. summary: Robot in 3 Days (Ri3D) at Iowa State is a low commitment club featuring build and training days during the fall semester and a 3-Day Build event in the beginning of January. This club stems from FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC), a competition where high schoolers build a robot in around 2 months to fulfill certain tasks based on the "game" for that year. The goal of Ri3D is to create the robot that would normally take 2 months, and design, code, wire, and build in 3 days to post onto social media platforms for high school FRC teams to use as inspiration for their own robot. The goal of Ri3D is not only to educate high school students, but to give university students an opportunity to be involved in FIRST Robotics past high school.
